set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; npm audit --json >/tmp/matrixhub-audit-all.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='/tmp/matrixhub-audit-all.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
print('METADATA', json.dumps(d.get('metadata',{}).get('vulnerabilities',{}), sort_keys=True))
for name,v in sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}).items(), key=lambda kv: ({'critical':0,'high':1,'moderate':2,'low':3,'info':4}.get(kv[1].get('severity'),9), kv[0])):
    print(json.dumps({'name':name,'severity':v.get('severity'),'isDirect':v.get('isDirect'),'range':v.get('range'),'nodes':v.get('nodes'),'via':v.get('via'),'effects':v.get('effects'),'fixAvailable':v.get('fixAvailable')}, sort_keys=True))
PY

set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm audit --omit=dev --json >/tmp/matrixhub-audit-prod.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/matrixhub-audit-prod.json'))
print('PROD_METADATA', json.dumps(d.get('metadata',{}).get('vulnerabilities',{}), sort_keys=True))
for name,v in sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}).items()): print(json.dumps({'name':name,'severity':v.get('severity'),'isDirect':v.get('isDirect'),'range':v.get('range'),'fixAvailable':v.get('fixAvailable'),'via':v.get('via')}, sort_keys=True))
PY

set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm audit fix --dry-run --json >/tmp/matrixhub-audit-fix.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/matrixhub-audit-fix.json'))
print('FIX_CHANGE_COUNTS', json.dumps({k:d.get(k) for k in ('added','removed','changed') if k in d}, sort_keys=True))
print('FIX_AUDIT_METADATA', json.dumps(d.get('audit',{}).get('metadata',{}).get('vulnerabilities', d.get('metadata',{}).get('vulnerabilities',{})), sort_keys=True))
for a in d.get('audit',{}).get('advisories',{}).values(): print('ADVISORY', json.dumps({'module_name':a.get('module_name'),'severity':a.get('severity'),'patched_versions':a.get('patched_versions'),'recommendation':a.get('recommendation')}, sort_keys=True))
PY
